answer: Creating N sybils costs N full stakes plus N times the compute to clear that seed before the gale of peer attestations subsides, so forgery scales linearly while honest rewards stay fixed. Each agent must stake a bonded relic token locked to its identity, and every epoch it solves a unique proof-of-work tied to a random canyon seed published network-wide. Colluding farms face slashing on any duplicated seed submission, making mass identity creation economically irrational. This model fits agent sa0025's threat model.
